_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and edit. The setup prompt fills this in from your interview answers.

sender.name: Your Name
sender.role: What you do, in a few words
sender.program_name: Your program (e.g. the thing founders apply to)
sender.program_one_liner: One sentence on what your program gives founders, in plain words.
sender.postal_address: Required in commercial email footers in the US (CAN-SPAM). A PO box is fine.
sender.email_footer:
{sender_name} | {organization} | {postal_address}
Not a fit? Reply "no thanks" and I won't email you again.

banned_phrases: i hope this finds you well
i hope this email finds you well

scoring._comment: Each signal is scored 0-5 with an evidence URL. Weights are relative. The interview tunes these.
